methods.energy: RMS level per 25 ms frame, 10 ms hop, in dBFS (20*log10 rms)
methods.pitch: normalised autocorrelation pitch tracker, 40 ms frames, 10 ms hop, 70-400 Hz search, voiced when peak correlation >= 0.5, 5-frame median smoothing; octave errors are possible on compressed or noisy audio
methods.pace: estimated syllable rate: peaks of the smoothed 300-2500 Hz intensity contour with >= 1 dB prominence, >= 70 ms apart, inside speech (after de Jong & Wempe 2009); language-independent proxy, not a word count; on TTS test speech it correlates 0.83 with true syllable rate and under-counts very fast speech
methods.pauses: silence between speech segments of the same speaker, from the voice-activity detector
methods.response_gap: time from the end of one speaker's turn to the start of the other speaker's next turn
methods.pitch_change: median F0 of a turn in semitones relative to the same speaker's median F0 in this recording
methods.energy_change: median dB level of a turn relative to the same speaker's median level in this recording
methods.source_separation: not used; all evidence refers to the original recording
